conditions of access

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to carry free-text conditions under which an asset may be accessed (schema:conditionsOfAccess) — on-site only, by appointment, embargoed until a date.

Avoid when

  • Avoid conflating access conditions with reuse licence terms (those are gmeow:hasLicense and the rule layer) and avoid using it for the free/paid signal, which is gmeow:isAccessibleForFree.

How to use

  • Set gmeow:conditionsOfAccess on the asset for prose access constraints; where access is a regulated action, also model it as a rule over a gmeow:RightsAction.

Examples

  • ex:archiveItem gmeow:conditionsOfAccess "On-site access only; by appointment.".

Use For Consumers
